boundary: Software input BLAKE2b, scratchpad AES fill, AES program generation and pinned native light dataset provider; hardware scratchpad transport, immutable preparation, execution, 7 interprogram hashes, finalizer/digest. Provider host seconds are separate. No complete ASIC, physical DRAM timing, MHz or watts claim.

native_reference.dataset: pinned initDatasetItem actual native dataset, light mode
native_reference.initialization_program_generation_interp: software providers separately timed; hardware seed/finalizer connected by lifecycle

host_provider.provider: pinned randomx::initDatasetItem, native light cache; not a physical DRAM model

prepared-ideal.record: PASS prepared_hash_lifecycle prepared=1 programs=8 iterations_per_program=2048 stall=0 total_iterations=16384 actual_instructions=6306885 bytecode_events=1434807 admissions=8 loaded_words=3072 hardware_seeds=7 initial_writes=131072 final_reads=131072 cycles=40975538 native_digest32=1 native_actual_dataset=1 full_scratchpad_bytes=2097152 ledger_closes=1

simulation_state_model: two-state; bounded cross-check with Icarus required
